Head lines 355-380 add stored state:
- autopilotAdoptedModelIDs (in-memory only)
- autopilotHolds
- autopilotBusyClock
- transitionWatchdog
- autopilotStalledCommandId
- startupPreloadStopRequested
- further fields hidden by the truncated patch excerpt

These are declarations only. The logic lives in companion files such as ProviderLoop+AutopilotPlacement, which were not supplied. No cryptographic, attestation, key-handling, or serving-authorization state changed in the visible text. Unchanged visible items include:
- NodeKeyPair.generate at base line 833 (A-003)
- the signer/attestationBuilder setup
- modelHashes/liveModelHashes, which feed the attestation challenge (T-012/T-027)

Integration questions:
- Can the new `detail` string in autopilotHistory carry operator- or coordinator-sourced content into outbound status messages or the daemon state file? This bears on T-058-style information leakage and log injection.
- Can placement adoption (autopilotAdoptedModelIDs) cause an inventory model to be served without passing the advertised-set guard, weight-hash verification, or self-test? The relevant controls are failedSelfTestHashes (base line 379) and the ensureModelLoaded advertised guard.
- Can the TransitionWatchdog cancellation path leave model slots or reservations inconsistent (T-029 availability)?
- Does startupPreloadStopRequested interact correctly with the registration gate?

None of these can be judged from the declarations alone. No regression is identified in the supplied source.
